text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thanks for letting me take time off. I spoiled myself a bit.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And what did I do? …I ignored my alarm three times!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Plus, I spent the entire day… in pajamas! How bourgeois!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And all that sleep made my skin look better too… Feels that way, at least!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Anyways, you can look forward to a new and improved Nature! Hehe, just kidding! ♪
